trust_decision.summary: Accepted: at the pinned commit addon.py:825 joins a PolyHaven API-response-controlled include path onto a temp dir and writes the downloaded body there at addon.py:831 with no containment check; the single-commit fix adds the isabs/'..'/abspath-containment guard that already exists in download_sketchfab_model.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names download_polyhaven_asset, so an engineer greps that name and lands on the handler; reading down the models branch reaches the unguarded include write at addon.py:825/831.

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tool download_polyhaven_asset (src/blender_mcp/server.py:480) -> TCP command 'download_polyhaven_asset' (addon.py:293) -> BlenderMCPServer.download_polyhaven_asset models branch
fix_sites.module_kind: Blender addon command handler (runs inside the bpy GUI process)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory and its one-hunk fix name only download_polyhaven_asset, so a solver can argue the Hunyuan3D importer's zip extraction and the model main-file name are other features that were never covered.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Include entries legitimately carry subdirectories (relative .bin/texture references used by the glTF import); flattening via os.path.basename or rejecting any '/' would break a valid model import.

O6_input_shapes: relative path with '..' segments in either separator spelling ('../x', '..\\x') - caught by the substring test
any path whose os.path.abspath falls outside abs_temp_dir + os.sep after os.path.normpath (containment check)
a mapping of several include entries: an unsafe entry is skipped with continue while safe siblings are still downloaded

O7_producer.where: addon.py:819-820 (include mapping taken from the PolyHaven files API JSON parsed at addon.py:562)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: import_generated_asset_hunyuan downloads a caller-supplied zip and calls zip_ref.extractall(temp_dir) with no entry-name check, so archive entries escape the temp dir and overwrite arbitrary files.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the separate Hunyuan3D integration (enabled by a different checkbox, addon.py:2679) reached by a different MCP tool, so the solver reads it as outside a PolyHaven advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: ~1550 lines below the fix site in the same file; its public entry point is in another package (src/blender_mcp/server.py:1100-1122) via handler addon.py:321

O8_uncovered_routes.route: In the same models branch the main model file is written to os.path.join(temp_dir, file_url.split('/')[-1]) with no containment check; a URL segment such as '..\\..\\.bashrc' escapes on Windows where the split-on-'/' name still contains separators.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: A solver reasons that split('/')[-1] cannot contain a separator so it cannot traverse, and never considers the Windows separator differential.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 10 lines above the fixed include join, same function

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second archive-to-temp-dir importer that extracts a subdirectory handed over by the API response (e.g. a 'root' field) alongside the existing zip-slip loop.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The sketchfab path already builds a per-entry target path, so a maintainer adding a nested-output option would naturally join an API-supplied prefix in the same block.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A model-sidecar writer using a response-provided relative name (a 'variant' or 'root' key) next to the main-file write.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The models branch already derives a filename from the API response ten lines above the include loop and writes it there; a maintainer adding sidecars would copy that line rather than the include guard.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal / zip-slip leading to arbitrary file write

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.10, setuptools/uv (pyproject.toml, uv.lock); package deps mcp[cli]>=1.3.0 and httpx>=0.27.0; the addon half additionally needs Blender with bpy
O10_build.project_tests: Only test_set_texture_version_guard.py (static AST/string checks for a different feature); no tests for PolyHaven or any download/write path.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap include_path in os.path.basename (or reject any include path containing '/') before joining, which keeps writes inside temp_dir but flattens legitimate subdirectories and leaves the Hunyuan extractall and the model main-file name untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Noted but not pursued: import_generated_asset_main_site passes a caller-supplied task_uuid as a NamedTemporaryFile prefix (addon.py:1462), which can carry path separators; the random suffix makes exact-path overwrite unlikely.
Committed at the pinned commit: test_set_texture_version_guard.py is a string/AST structural test of a different feature, not a behavioural test.
